thread.title: 5 Business Stories You Must Watch Wednesday Premarket

author: Home
title: 5 Business Stories You Must Watch Wednesday Premarket
text:
Here's everything you must know before Wednesday's opening bell :
Apple ( AAPL ) earned $2.73 a share on revenue of $61.1 billion, beating earnings forecasts of $2.67. Tesla ( TSLA ) is expected to report a first-quarter loss of $3.54 a share after the bell. Xerox ( XRX ) reached a settlement to bring on 6 dissident-backed directors and oust the technology company's CEO, Jeff Jacobson. Snap ( SNAP ) said a redesign of its signature Snapchat app would slow ad sale revenue in the months ahead. U.S. stock futures were on the rise, led by Apple.
